_readme: Yugo Austin Nueces, 2502 Nueces. +u east, +v north. Photo-derived six-storey street frontage, seven-storey long wing, eight-storey white setback volume. Green projections cover two storeys each, not the full height. Dimensions inferred, not surveyed; unseen north and west elevations conservative. No projecting apartment balconies visible: only rooftop terraces. Fine panel seams, railing infill and vector branding use the renderer sign cutoff 0.6; main mass and glazing remain on phones.
name: Yugo Austin Nueces

sources.geometry: Existing footprint retained; exterior geometry inferred from two local reference views.
